pages.text: Rounds a number to the nearest integer.$(br2)A .5 goes to the nearest even integer: 12.5 becomes 12, 13.5 becomes 14. A number too large for an INTEGER raises NUMERIC_OVERFLOW.
$(li)$(1)value$() INTEGER|FLOAT: the number$(li)result $(1)result$() INTEGER: the rounded number
$(1)CALL c0de/math/ROUND$(br)  PARAMETER value 12.5 ;$(br)  RESULT result rounded$()
